hostel_intro: A safe, caring, and supportive residential home for students and youths of all ages and classes to learn, grow, and build their future. Providing quality accommodation, wholesome nutrition, disciplined study coaching, and warmth for every educational stage.
vision_statement: Provide a safe, caring, disciplined and supportive environment where students of all ages and educational stages can learn, grow and develop into responsible, self-reliant individuals.
vision_pillar1: Nurturing & Secure Home with 24/7 guardian supervision and medical support
vision_pillar2: Quality Education for All Stages from Primary to Higher Secondary, College & Vocational Training
vision_pillar3: Nutritious Diet, Sports, Yoga, and Cultural Arts for holistic physical and mental wellbeing
vision_pillar4: Values of Integrity, Discipline, Mutual Respect, and Community Service
founder_bio: BRO.NELSON A dedicated over 20 years to child welfare, youth development, and educational reform. Having witnessed the struggles of disadvantaged students deprived of schooling and stable care, he established RISE A CHILD CHILDREN HOME with a heartfelt mission to ensure every child receives loving shelter, education, and moral guidance.
founder_vision: Every child possesses boundless potential. When provided with safety, balanced nutrition, education, and genuine affection, they flourish into confident, self-reliant individuals.
founder_message: To our dearest children: this home is your family. Dream without fear. To our revered guardians: trust us with your hope, we nurture your children as our own. And to our generous supporters: your kindness is the light that illuminates their path. Thank you for walking beside us.
